title: ReMedI: Inference-Time Refinement and Self-Distillation for Controllable Molecular Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.32103v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In drug development, lead optimization must improve competing properties, such as increasing permeability and reducing toxicity, while limiting scaffold changes that could compromise the lead's potency. RL-based post-training, such as C-MORAL, addresses this problem by fine-tuning molecular language models to directly optimize molecular leads for objectives of interest, which relies on expensive task-specific datasets and faces challenges in achieving multi-objective optimization (MOO). We argue a pre-trained model may already contain useful molecular edits that zero-shot generation cannot efficiently reach. Motivated by the limited search capabilities of zero-shot generation, we develop an efficient Metropolis-Hastings search strategy to better explore the proposal distribution. translated_title: ReMedI：基于推理时细化与自蒸馏的可控分子优化
translated_abstract: 在药物研发中，先导化合物优化必须在改善相互竞争的性质（例如提高渗透性、降低毒性）的同时，限制可能损害先导化合物药效的骨架变化。基于强化学习的后训练方法（如C-MORAL）通过微调分子语言模型来直接针对感兴趣的目标优化分子先导化合物，从而解决这一问题，但这类方法依赖于昂贵的任务特定数据集，并且在实现多目标优化（MOO）方面面临挑战。我们认为，预训练模型可能已经包含有用的分子编辑操作，而零样本生成无法高效地触及这些操作。受零样本生成搜索能力有限的启发，我们开发了一种高效的Metropolis-Hastings搜索策略，以更好地探索提议分布。我们提出了ReMedI，该方法利用分子语言模型作为基础提议者进行推理时对齐。给定一个先导化合物和一组多目标任务……
tldr: 该论文提出ReMedI方法，以分子语言模型作为基础提议者，结合高效的Metropolis-Hastings搜索策略与推理时细化及自蒸馏，在无需昂贵任务特定数据集的情况下实现可控的多目标分子先导化合物优化。
